derivation.tower: tools/scans/align-tower.mjs + global-reg.mjs + finalize-tower.mjs (alignment) then tools/scans/build-tower.mjs (crop, fragment removal, chart re-atlas to one JPEG, per-vertex relight of the photographed wall sun to the game sun (COLOR_0, atlas texels unchanged), meshoptimizer far LOD, cuts + authored window strips (near), authored belfry and clock dials (both LODs), roof rail and mast (near), collider heightfield from the visible tops)
derivation.field: tools/scans/stadium-level.mjs + stadium-align.mjs (alignment) then tools/scans/build-stadium.mjs (field-only crop, flatten, re-atlas)
derivation.westStand: tools/scans/stand-probe.mjs (bowl section reach from the real authored scene) then tools/scans/build-stand.mjs (west-straight crop, fragment removal, clean rim line + trim of torn rim/press-box remnants; original source photo UV charts kept (tools/scans/stand-charts.mjs: no position weld across UV seams), used source texel regions re-packed at scale 1 into a 4096x2048 atlas (exact source texels, no colour/exposure edits), UV-aware meshoptimizer simplifyWithAttributes LODs that keep chart seams, far LOD embeds the same full-resolution atlas JPEG (no downsampling); reduced collider surface, seam profiles); transform = dkr-field.json. Fidelity: tools/scans/stand-fidelity.mjs
derivation.towerTools: Pinned offline authoring dependencies: tools/scans/tower-tools.package.json; setup in tools/scans/tower-reference-notes.md. Not game dependencies.

authoredInfill: ut-tower GLBs: COLOR_0 relight multiplier per vertex (fitted photographed wall sun az 217 deg -> game sun az 121.2 deg, luminance-clamped); atlas texels unchanged except the 7758 sky-blue bleed texels on the lantern rim desaturated (that area is now cut)

ut-tower near GLB: 12 shaft window strips cut from the scan and replaced by authored recessed panels (registered to the scanned bands: centres, 1.2 m width, 2.5875 m floor pitch, 16 spandrels) + stone reveals; pattern drawn from reference proportions (CC0 Commons close-up), no photographic texels

ut-tower GLBs: belfry above Y 94.9 (inside 5.35 m of the crown centre) replaced by an authored four-fold symmetric belfry (podium, pedestals, 16 columns, corner piers, bell chamber, architrave/frieze/cornice, attic, roof at 108.85) fitted to the scan half-extent profile and photographs; textured with captured limestone (orthographic resample of the scanned north/east shaft wall, mean-normalised) plus drawn 0.5 m course / 1.2 m head joints

ut-tower GLBs: four clock dials (r 2.05 m, centre Y 91.15, measured from orthographic scan crops) replacing the melted rings; dial drawn from reference photographs (gold bezel, pale blue-green field, red radial Roman numerals), hands at 10:45 (game sun time)
ut-tower near GLB: roof guard rail and lattice mast with two whip antennas (position triangulated from two GPS-tagged Commons photographs, +-0.7 m; heights estimated); no colliders
ut-tower GLBs: the former flat grey lantern lid is removed (superseded by the authored roof)

dkr-west-stand GLBs: 622 interior hole cells (1,244 triangles) surfaced at the hole-filled collider height - 0.03 m, separate untextured unlit material "DKR west stand authored infill (flat approximate capture tone)" (extras.authoredInfill), tone = median source texel of nearby captured faces

stadium-bowl.ts (generated, not in the GLB): rim parapet + roof cap from the clean rim line to the outer wall, and a press-box box fitted to the surviving scanned slab extents (dkr-west-stand.json sector.pressBox)
towerReferences: 26 reference photographs used only as geometry/drawing guidance, not shipped textures: tools/scans/tower-references.json. Measured reconstruction, budgets, limitations and reproducible authoring setup: tools/scans/tower-reference-notes.md. Captured texels come only from the MIT utimagery scan.
